Lullaby UI (0.0.0)

A component library for UI composer, with a premium feel.

graphics
ui-composer

UI Composer is a wonderful piece of technology, allowing the creation of truly native UI with the development experience of modern web development. It has immense amounts of potential.

But like any FOSS project, potential alone can't win anybody over.

Lullaby UI is a UI library built on top of UI Composer that shows what it can do. Visually, it's the best from Apple's Human Interface Guidelines, Google's Material 3 Expressive, and libadwaita with a lot of its own flair.

Made with HTML by Pedro Braga
